about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a freelance programmer and web developer based in the Marche region, currently completing a degree in Computer Science at the University of Camerino. I specialize in modern website creation and software development, combining advanced technical skills with a strong focus on usability and SEO.
about.p2: I approach every project with an analytical approach: from a simple showcase site to complex web applications. I believe in code quality and actively participate in the open-source community to stay up-to-date on the latest technologies.

experiences.description: Design and development of responsive, SEO-optimized websites and custom software applications. I independently manage the entire digital product lifecycle: from strategic requirements analysis to frontend and backend development, through to deployment, testing, and ongoing maintenance.

Curricular internship (320 hours) completed as part of my Computer Science Bachelor's degree at UNICAM. I worked on the creation and restyling of websites (landing pages and multi-page sites) and the development of various web-based software (both management and non-management applications). My tasks also included CMS management, WordPress blog content configuration, and developing a custom conversion tool to transform static code (HTML/CSS/JS) into Elementor-compatible WordPress themes.

Internship focused on analyzing and resolving bugs (bug fixing) within existing software applications, significantly improving overall stability and efficiency. I collaborated with the IT team to design and implement new features, applying rigorous testing and debugging methodologies in a structured development environment.

Work-Study Program (120 hours) representing my first direct experience in a corporate IT setting. I supported the development team with operational programming tasks, gaining hands-on knowledge of team dynamics, software development workflows, and industry best practices under the mentorship of senior developers.

items.question: Why is there such a large price gap between web developers?
items.answer: The price difference reflects standard low-cost templates versus engineered, custom-coded strategic platforms built for high performance, deep SEO, and high conversion rates.

items.question: What are the hidden costs of cheap websites?
items.answer: Cheap sites act as a 'sunk cost': they are poorly optimized, slow, generic, and will cost you thousands in lost customers and tarnished brand reputation over time.

items.question: What are the standard phases of custom web development?
items.answer: The process includes 5 key steps: Discovery & Strategy, UX/UI Architecture, Technical Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA) Testing, and Deployment.

items.question: Do you provide post-deployment support and training?
items.answer: Yes, every digital project handover includes technical documentation, team training, and automated CI/CD pipeline setup for ongoing maintenance.

items.question: What is included in a professional maintenance retainer?
items.answer: A solid plan provides total peace of mind: routine vulnerability patching, Core Web Vitals monitoring, API functionality checks, and guaranteed disaster recovery backups.

items.question: What exactly happens right after I contact you?
items.answer: We start with an in-depth discovery call (or a coffee, if you're in the Marche region) to analyze the bottlenecks in your current workflow and the must-have features for a first release, before any code or quote is discussed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit this site.
privacy.dataControllerText: The Data Controller for the data collected through this site is Leonardo Castignani, reachable at info@leonardocastignani.it.
privacy.dataText: When you fill out the contact form, we collect the information you provide, such as name, email, and message, solely to reply to you. We do not share this information with third parties.
privacy.cookieText1: This site uses cookies to improve your experience. The cookies used are listed below:
privacy.cookieTypesIntro: Cookies on this site fall into two categories:
privacy.technicalCookiesText: Essential for the site to work correctly (e.g. storing your consent choice). They do not require prior consent, as they are necessary to provide the service.
privacy.analyticsCookiesText: Through Google Tag Manager, analytics cookies (e.g. Google Analytics) may be activated to understand how visitors use the site, in aggregated and anonymized form. These cookies are activated ONLY if you choose "Accept all" in the cookie banner, in line with Google Consent Mode: by default all tracking is set to "denied" until you give explicit consent.

cookieConsent.title: Technical Consent Cookie (cookieconsent_status)
cookieConsent.text: This cookie stores your choice regarding cookie consent ("all" or "required only"), so the banner is not shown again on every visit. It lasts 12 months.

privacy.cookieText2: No profiling cookie is installed without your explicit consent.
privacy.legalBasisText: Processing of technical cookies is based on the Controller's legitimate interest in the proper functioning of the site. Processing of analytics cookies is based on your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
privacy.retentionText: Data collected through the contact form is kept for as long as needed to respond to your request. The technical cookie that stores your consent choice lasts 12 months, after which your consent will be requested again. Analytics cookies set by Google, if you consent, follow the retention periods set by Google itself (up to 24 months): see Google's Cookie Policy for up-to-date details.
privacy.manageConsentText: You can change your choice at any time by deleting this site's cookies from your browser settings: on your next visit, the consent banner will be shown again.
privacy.rightsText: As a data subject, you have the right to access your personal data, request rectification or erasure, object to processing, request restriction or portability, and lodge a complaint with the competent Data Protection Authority.
privacy.aiTransparencyText1: Some content on this site, particularly blog articles, is drafted with the support of generative artificial intelligence tools. Every piece of content is always reviewed, verified, and personally validated by Leonardo Castignani before publication, who remains its sole editorial responsible party.
privacy.aiTransparencyText2: This site currently does not use chatbots, virtual assistants, or other artificial intelligence systems that interact directly with visitors. Should such a feature be introduced in the future, it will be explicitly disclosed here, in compliance with Article 50 of EU Regulation 2024/1689 (AI Act).
privacy.contactText: For any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact me through the form on this site or by email.
